description: Keep something for later tasks. file is a page as memory_read names them; text is a line to add, or a whole block (a new page's frontmatter and sections, or an episodic entry); replacing swaps a passage for text. Mid-task, only what the user asked you to keep or what they'll clearly want again; the quiet turn after the task writes the day's episodic entry. Never passwords, codes, card numbers or other secrets.
name: remember
title: Remember
